sloka: तथा स्त्रियो राम निमित्तम् आतुरा ।यथा सुते भ्रातरि वा विवासिते ।विलप्य दीना रुरुदुर् विचेतसः ।सुतैः हि तासाम् अधिको हि सो अभवत् ॥२-४८-३६॥
transliteration: tathā striyo rāma nimittam āturā ।yathā sute bhrātari vā vivāsite ।vilapya dīnā rurudur vicetasaḥ ।sutaiḥ hi tāsām adhiko hi so abhavat ॥2-48-36॥

translations.english: The women grieved over Rama as if a son or a brother had been exiled. Depressed and distressed, they wept and sobbed. For them, Rama was indeed more than their sons.
